items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-09-18
items.q: Milford Piron, my teacher. Armand Piron.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Lots of musicians in. Lots of musicians. Who were some of the other ones that you... What were the other ones that you...

Well, uh... Milford Piron, my teacher. Armand Piron. Thank you. Louis Cottrell's daddy. Bonnie Bigard, the Teos. Lorenzo Junior, Lorenzo Senior. Big I, Louis. Well, we could just go on and name quite a number of them. Piku.
The guys your age, how many of them are there? Let's see.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: Armand Piron is cousin to me through marriage.

ctx.x: Was Milford Piron akin to AJ?
That's AJ's older brother. I see. Piron is cousin, Armand Piron is cousin to me through marriage.
Well Dick said to tell you that Bill Phillips is a bass drummer now with the Young Tuxedo Brass Band.
